red_flags: Accredited (page states Akkreditierung: Ja) M.Eng. at a staatlich anerkannt public Hochschule - a REAL master's degree, best-in-class for the visa. BUT: SUMMER-SEMESTER-ONLY INTAKE - a September 2027 start is impossible; nearest starts are Sommersemester 2027 (approx. March 2027) or Sommersemester 2028. German language of instruction. Admission is subject-specific and expects a theatre/event-technology bachelor; a generalist software-engineering diploma may require bridging modules or be refused. fit_notes: masters_degree - THE strongest genuine fit on this path anywhere in scope: a full engineering master's in event and theatre technology (rigging, stage machinery, event electrics, sound and lighting systems, safety, production management) at a public German university of applied sciences, tuition-free. Client's 300-ECTS engineering diploma far exceeds the 210-credit threshold mentioned, so the additional-modules clause on credit volume should not bite - the risk is subject match, not credit volume. Intake timing conflicts with the September 2027 target: raise with BHT directly.

red_flags: Fully accredited public-university M.Sc. (staatlich anerkannt), tuition-free - the cleanest visa and funding profile in Berlin. HARD BARRIER: German C1 certificate required for applicants with foreign qualifications; the whole programme is taught in German. Not a live-sound production degree: it is an audio technology and acoustics research master (electroacoustics, room and virtual acoustics, DSP, psychoacoustics), so PA/line-array system design appears only as underlying theory.
fit_notes: masters_degree - the best ENGINEERING-side fit for a software engineer in Berlin: admission explicitly names engineering degrees and requires exactly the maths and programming the client already has (yes_explicit; 300 ECTS massively exceeds any credit bar). Winter-semester intake aligns with a September/October 2027 start. Language is the gate, not the credential - German C1 by 2027 would be the whole project.

program_name: Master Universitario en Ingenieria Acustica (Master's Degree in Acoustic Engineering)

red_flags: Genuine TITULO OFICIAL (official Spanish master's, RUCT-registered) at a public university - fully visa-safe and the only official Spanish master's found that touches sound-system engineering. Taught in Spanish. Content is acoustics engineering (architectural, environmental, underwater, electroacoustics, materials) - NOT live sound, front-of-house or touring production; the overlap is electroacoustics and system measurement. Gandia is a small coastal campus 65 km south of Valencia, not Barcelona/Madrid.
fit_notes: masters_degree - a real official master's where the client's credential is unambiguously sufficient (300 ECTS vs a 240-ECTS Spanish engineering norm; admission is by record, so likely rather than yes_explicit). Dedicated non-EU application phase opening in November is unusually early - diarise. Best Spanish option if the client will accept acoustics engineering as the academic frame for a live-sound career.

Tuition figure is the key unknown; UPM's non-EU surcharge rule can push the price well above the headline public rate.

SAE Barcelona separately describes itself as a private higher arts education school in music regulated by AQU - that applies to its music degree, not to this master.

Client's engineering diploma satisfies the bachelor requirement. Include only if the client accepts a non-official award; funding-first strategy argues against it.

It is a generic professional-practice wrapper around SAE's disciplines, not a live-sound engineering master. Treat as a lead requiring direct contact, not as a verified option.
